feeds.title: Goonhammer
feeds.description: Find articles on wargames like Warhammer 40k and many more! Goonhammer is an extremely real website full of Posts and Friends. A site for wargamers, boardgamers, goons and non-goons alike.

feeds.title: Warhammer 40K Blog
feeds.description: A 40K blog about my journey back into the 40K universe with the Imperial Guard. Hobby Bits, Battle Reports, Learnings and Tactics.

feeds.title: The Brush and Boltgun
feeds.description: A wargaming, hobby and painting blog. Creating step by step painting video tutorials for tabletop miniatures. Get your miniatures looking great on the tabletop.

feeds.title: Table Standard
feeds.description: A Warhammer 40k wargaming hobby blog of a Games Workshop fanboy. Painting to a table standard.

feeds.title: Awesome Lies Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a vehicle for my thoughts on Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay and related matters. The focus is on WFRP's first edition, but I also touch on WFRP's fourth edition, WFB's first three editions and other old-school tabletop games.

feeds.title: Bell of Lost Souls » Warhammer 40k
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the popular game Warhammer 40k. Bell of Lost Souls is the leading tabletop gaming news and pop culture enthusiast website. Our nonstop 365 coverage of the tabletop games and entertainment industry covers Wizards of the Coast, Games Workshop, Privateer Press, Fantasy Flight Games, Paizo, Kickstarter, and other board games, RPG, and tabletop product lines and the gaming community itself.

feeds.title: Tale of Painters
feeds.description: Tale of Painter is an unofficial Warhammer hobby magazine and painting blog. Since 2011, we bring you free tutorials, in-depth reviews, and stunning pictures of our painted miniatures for your inspiration. The works of our contributors have been featured in White Dwarf, Warhammer Visions, and on Warhammer Community numerous times.

feeds.title: Warhammer Armies Project
feeds.description: Welcome to the Warhammer Armies Project, the home of the unofficial 9th Edition for Warhammer Fantasy Battles and the most popular unofficial army books online. Here you can download all the rules, lore and art for the game, as well as get information on the latest updates and new releases!

feeds.title: Can You Roll A Crit?
feeds.description: A Warhammer 40,000 Kill Team and Warhammer Underworlds Blog. Whether it be tactics, tutorials, or event rundowns, this place will be having something to appeal to all your Underworlds' needs!

feeds.title: Between the Bolter and Me
feeds.description: Between the Bolter and Me is a group of three brothers dedicated to critically exploring the miniature wargaming hobby, with a primary focus on Warhammer 40,000 and other Games Workshop games. Rather than focus on rules and competitive play, our priority is exploring the imagery of Warhammer 40,000 and injecting some realism into it, be it through more plausible anatomy or more functional firearms.

feeds.title: Warpstone Flux
feeds.description: Warhammer 40,000, Warhammer, Horus Heresy, Roleplaying Games, Painting, and other assorted tabletop gaming and hobbies! In a nutshell, this blog is primarily a tabletop gaming and hobby chronicle. It is about jabberjabber's adventures with (but by no means limited to) Warhammer 40,000 & 30,000 armies such as the Alpha Legion, chaos space marines, chaos daemons and other armies.

feeds.title: 40k Hobby Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to the hobby aspect of Games Workshop's Warhammer 40k universe. This blog covers painting, converting, scratch building, and sometimes even playing Imperial Guard, Space Marines, Blood Angels, or other armies as I get around to painting them.

feeds.title: Grim Dark Filthy Casuals
feeds.description: Learn more about the warhammer 40k game, gameplay and more! A Chicago metropolitan-based Warhammer 40K group consisting of a diverse community of mostly socially well-adjusted, hygiene compliant, fun individuals. Our mission is to boldly grow a community of Grim Dark Filthy Casuals who invest themselves in encouraging and supporting each other to level-up our tabletop enjoyment, passion, knowledge; and overall skill of the game, hobby, and life.

feeds.title: Battle Bunnies
feeds.description: Explore our gameplays in the blog. The Battle Bunnies are a 30k era Gaming club out of Milton Keynes, England (though we do have an international Contributor now). We were founded in October 2011. Currently there are 9 members, and most of us meet 2 or 3 times a week for Battles, painting nights and fluff discussions.

feeds.title: Plastic Craic Blog
feeds.description: A Warhammer Age of Sigmar Blog. I'm an orc guy. My own hobby is pretty heavily Destruction-focused, and that will of course be reflected in the Blog. My goal is to give people some Warhamms to read about.

feeds.title: WeeMen Blog
feeds.description: Find tutorials for miniature figure buildings for wargames and tabletop games. The author is an Average Hobbyist centered around GW products and Sci Fi.

feeds.title: The Hoodling's Hole
feeds.description: The Hoodling's Hole is a fantasy wargaming blog. My name is Greg Johnson, I live in Melbourne, Australia, and I am a gamer.

feeds.title: Confessions of a 40k addict
feeds.description: A Warhammer 40K and hobby blog focusing on painting, modelling, battle reports, terrain tutorials and templates and free downloads.

feeds.title: Faeit 212 Blog
feeds.description: Find Articles about list building, tactics, dice, where to play, and everything else related to warhammer 40k. I have no mission statement, dont really care if anyone reads this blog. Its not about you. Its about me, and my 40k obession that has been going on for quite some time, and needs a place to vent, post, talk rules, etc.

feeds.title: Iron Sleet
feeds.description: Find Iron SleetRaw, Grim, Dark, Northern European collective of miniature artists and illustrators. Browse articles featuring various figures and illustrations.

feeds.title: Recalcitrant Daze
feeds.description: Recalcitrant Daze is an account of all the things I have done. Completed projects will be posted with in-depth details.

feeds.title: Stepping Between Games
feeds.description: I started this site, on blogspot, many moons ago to try and cronicle my attempts at getting games published. Indeed if you look all the way back those posts are still there.

feeds.title: Chucking Monkeys
feeds.description: I am now collecting, converting and painting Warhammer 40k miniatures. Just when I thought I'd reached the nadir of geek obsession, I have discovered a whole new sub-level of anorak-wearing strangeness. Explore my collection of miniature and articles depicting their progress in this blog.

feeds.title: The Vanus Temple
feeds.description: The Vanus Temple is a full time professional commission painting service based in Hull, UK. Based in Hull, UK, TVT Studio specialises in painting tabletop miniatures from Warhammer 40,000, Warhammer Fantasy, The Hobbit and Mantic Games.

feeds.title: Variance Hammer
feeds.description: A miniatures wargaming and Warhammer 40K blog with a focus on the math and statistics behind the game. This blog is my musings on probability in Warhammer 40k, the hobby in general, and generally trying to apply math, statistics and simulation to one of my favorite games.

feeds.title: Sepulchre of Heroes
feeds.description: Drink Deep of Victory and Remember the Fallen. A Blood Angels oriented Warhammer 40,000 Hobby, Fluff, and Tactics Blog. A Miniature Wargaming hobby and tactics blog. Focused mostly on Warhammer 40,000.

feeds.title: The Hammer of Wrath
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to painting and converting Warhammer 40K models, primarily for Tau, Space Marines, and Grey Knights. Here I'll be posting various articles focused on the hobby aspect of 40K, including tutorials, works in progress, showcases of finished miniatures and scenery, and product reviews. I'm an experienced miniatures painter and hobbyist, having completed several armies and multiple terrain tables, as well as commissioned pieces for friends and clients.

feeds.title: Four Dads of the Apocalypse
feeds.description: A blog by Four Dads who like playing Apocalypse games of 40k. Some of us love painting more, some of us love gaming more, but we all love all things 40k and Horus Heresy related.

feeds.title: Didcot Wargames Club
feeds.description: 40k blog focussing on my different armies. Find Regular hobby and Battle Report posts. I mostly play 40k with a bit of fantasy once in a while in the St Andrews area. I plan to post on my existing armies, what I am working on and some battle reports from my weekly gaming sessions.

feeds.title: The Gloryseekers
feeds.description: The Gloryseekers is an informational blog run by Craig and Jacko. We're just a couple of gamers who love playing Tabletop games, including Warhammer Underworlds. We play competitively, regularly participate in local tournaments and appear as guests on the Tabletop Sydney Youtube Channel. The only rule we have on this blog is no balance whining. We focus on the gameplay side of Warhammer Underworlds, not warband or card balance concerns. While criticism of the game's balance is occasionally warranted, this does not teach people how to play better.

feeds.title: Classic Warhammer 40K
feeds.description: Painting diary focused on Warhammer 40K 2nd ed., 5th ed. WHFB, related GW games, and miscellaneous whimsy. I originally started this blog as a personal record of my painting and hobby activity. My main hobby passions revolve around trying to recreate the armies I wished I could have had when I first got into gaming in the 90s; mainly Warhammer 40K 2nd edition and 5th edition Warhammer Fantasy Battle.

feeds.title: Warhamateur Blog
feeds.description: Guides, blogs, tutorials and reviews by regular hobbyists - because in Warhammer sometimes enthusiasm is more important than skill!

feeds.title: Total War Blog
feeds.description: Spanning feudal Japan, the Roman era, Medieval Europe and 18th century France, the Total War series brings the past to life with a unique mix of turn-based strategy and real-time land and naval battles.

feeds.title: Faux Hammer Blog
feeds.description: Faux Hammer Blog for is for Miniature Painters, Hobbyists and fans of Painting Games Workshop Miniatures. We also review Tools and Accessories used to support your modelling goals.

feeds.title: Vanguard Tactics Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Vanguard Tactics Blog Page. Here you will find articles written by Vanguard Tactics's player in regards to competitive play, hobby and sportsmanship. You will also find all of the podcast episode show notes, where you can download lists, cheat sheets and listen to the podcast.
